name: Touchscreen smartphone
definition: touchscreen smartphone in one rigid slab-shaped body.

name: Keyboard smartphone
definition: Smartphone in one piece with a fixed physical keyboard below the screen.

name: Flip foldable phone
definition: smartphone whose flexible screen folds across its width into a compact square.

name: Book foldable phone
definition: smartphone whose flexible screen folds along its length and opens like a book into a tablet-sized screen.

name: Keypad phone
definition: Basic mobile phone in one rigid body with a keypad and no smartphone features; taco and other one-piece shapes included.

name: Flip phone
definition: non-smartphone mobile phone whose body folds on a hinge (clamshell).

name: Slider phone
definition: Mobile phone whose screen half slides over the keypad half.

name: Swivel phone
definition: Mobile phone whose screen half rotates on a pivot to show the keypad.

name: Satellite phone
definition: handheld phone that places calls through satellites rather than a cellular network.

name: Landline phone
definition: Telephone for a fixed line, corded or cordless (DECT).

name: Walkie-talkie
definition: battery-powered push-to-talk transceiver held in the hand.

name: Vehicle two-way radio
definition: Two-way radio made to be installed in a vehicle.

name: Base-station radio
definition: Fixed two-way radio run from mains power at one site.

name: Pager
definition: small receiver that alerts its carrier and shows short messages sent over a paging network.

name: Tablet
definition: Touchscreen computer in one flat body, sold without a keyboard; an optional keyboard cover is sold separately.

name: E-reader
definition: Device sold for reading e-books, usually on an e-paper screen.

name: E-paper writing tablet
definition: E-paper device sold for taking notes and handwriting with a stylus.

name: Electronic organiser
definition: pocket device that keeps a diary, address book and notes (digital diary).

name: PDA
definition: handheld personal digital assistant running applications on a small screen with stylus or keyboard.

name: Electronic dictionary
definition: handheld device holding one or more dictionaries for look-up.

name: Pocket translator
definition: handheld device that translates speech or text between languages.

name: Smartwatch
definition: Wrist device with a display that runs apps and notifications; GPS sports watches are included.

name: Hybrid smartwatch
definition: analogue-hand watch with built-in sensors and phone connection.

name: Fitness band
definition: slim wrist band with a small display that tracks activity, sleep and heart rate.

name: Screenless band
definition: wrist band with sensors and no display, read through a phone app.

name: Smart ring
definition: finger ring with sensors that tracks health and activity.

name: Smart glasses
definition: Glasses with a see-through display, camera or speakers; a headset that encloses the eyes is in Video Games.

name: Hiking GPS
definition: portable satellite-navigation unit with maps made to be carried on foot outdoors.

name: Handheld GPS with two-way radio
definition: Handheld GPS unit with a two-way radio in the same case.

name: Golf GPS
definition: handheld or clip-on GPS unit that gives distances on golf courses.

name: Car sat-nav
definition: Portable navigation unit with road maps, sold to be moved between vehicles; a mounted one is in Vehicles.

name: Satellite messenger
definition: handheld device that sends and receives text messages and SOS alerts through satellites.

name: Personal locator beacon
definition: one-way distress beacon that sends a position to rescue services via satellite.

name: Bluetooth item tracker
definition: small tag attached to an item and located through a phone's finding network.

name: GPS tracker
definition: Tracker with its own GPS and cellular link (SIM, subscription), carried by a person or put in a bag; animal trackers are in Animal Equipment, vehicle trackers in Vehicles.

name: Power bank
definition: Portable rechargeable battery that charges phones and other devices.

name: Magnetic power bank
definition: Power bank that attaches magnetically to the back of a phone and charges it wirelessly.

name: Phone case
definition: case or cover made to hold and protect one phone model.

name: Tablet case
definition: case or cover made to hold and protect one tablet model.

name: Screen protector
definition: film or glass sheet cut to cover the screen of one device.

name: Watch strap
definition: replacement strap made for one smartwatch or band.

name: Charging dock
definition: dock, stand or puck charger made for one device.

name: Stylus
definition: Pen made for the screen of one range of tablets or phones.

name: Tablet keyboard cover
definition: Cover with a keyboard made for one range of tablets.

name: E-reader cover
definition: case or cover made to protect one e-reader model.

name: Phone battery case
definition: phone case with a built-in battery that charges the phone.

name: Clip-on phone lens
definition: add-on lens that clips over a phone camera.

name: Phone gimbal
definition: motorised handheld stabiliser made for a phone.

name: Selfie stick
definition: extendable pole that holds a phone for self-portraits.

name: Phone game controller
definition: game controller that clips onto a phone.

name: Satellite hotspot
definition: portable unit that links phones over Wi-Fi to a satellite network for calls, messages and data, with no keypad or screen of its own.

name: Phone microphone
definition: Microphone made to plug into or clip onto a phone and record through it; one made for cameras that also takes a phone is in Cameras & Photography or Musical Instruments & Music Gear.

name: Translator earbuds
definition: Pair of earbuds sold for translating speech between languages through a phone app; ordinary earbuds with a translate feature are in Audio & Video.

name: Dual-screen phone
definition: smartphone with two rigid touchscreens joined by a hinge, used apart or as one larger screen (not a flexible foldable screen).

name: DECT repeater
definition: unit that extends the range of a cordless (DECT) phone's base station to its handsets.
